purpose: Ideas and product decisions worth keeping but not necessarily implementing immediately.

items.title: @ mention autocomplete
items.notes: Typing @ should offer every AI character plus Al Jama'a. Mentioning a character is an explicit request for that character to respond.

items.title: Mention the whole crew
items.notes: Mentioning Al Jama'a requires every character in the user's crew to respond.

items.title: Natural social response orchestration
items.notes: The author of a post/comment being replied to should respond. Explicitly mentioned characters must respond. Other characters may optionally join based on probability so conversations do not feel like a chorus of bots.

items.title: Relationship-aware participation
items.notes: Optional responders should later be selected using relationships between characters, topic relevance, conversation history and personality rather than uniform randomness.

items.title: Adaptive Arabic/transcription mode
items.notes: Future third feed-language mode that gradually shifts the learner from Hebrew transcription toward Arabic script based on demonstrated reading comfort.
